افترضا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَضَا (iftaraḍā) /if.ta.ra.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اُفْتُرِضَا (ufturiḍā) /uf.tu.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اِفْتَرِضَا (iftariḍā) /if.ta.ri.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
